Settings

Display
Anybody OFL · titles fitted to the column by the width axis
Text
Chivo OFL
Moves
variable-font axis motion, width as hierarchy
Mood
bold, artful, elastic, confident
Case
Fitted titles in capitals; track names in sentence case at a narrow width; labels wide.
Numerals and features
font-variation-settings: "wdth" <fitted>

SLOW RIVERSLOW RIVER

A script measures the line and picks the width (60 to 150; if 60 is still too wide, the size steps down) that fills the column, so short and long titles both sit flush at the same size.
Signature
Titles are fitted to the column by the width axis, not by size: every release title spans edge to edge at the same 176 px, wide for short names and narrow for long ones. On load the width eases into place once.
Use when
Record labels, music releases, galleries, festivals, portfolio indexes with names of different lengths.
Turns into slop when
When the width keeps animating, when every heading on the page is fitted, or when fitting squeezes text below width 60 where it stops reading.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
